species.name: White bass
why: Water 71°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 18–22 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 9 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
